overview: Belle Collective centers on the personal and professional lives of five successful, glamourous boss women who are redefining what it means to be a southern belle in Jackson, Mississippi. These dynamic women represent Mississippi's finest Black female entrepreneurs, determined to break ceilings–glass and otherwise–while shredding long-held stereotypes of the South. They must set aside their differences to redevelop a struggling mid-twentieth century historic district that was once known as the hub for Black-owned businesses.
title: Belle Collective

overview: The series examines a gripping murder case in which unearthing a victim's body is the key to solving the twisted crime. Each episode features a suspenseful exhumation that has led to shocking new breakthroughs, unexpected plot-twists, and ultimately, justice being served.
title: Exhumed

overview: Zak Bagans counts down fans' favorite moments from Ghost Adventures. It's a fun yet terrifying walk down memory lane as Zak revisits the scariest, funniest and most insane clips from episodes past and presents some of the crew's best paranormal evidence.
title: Ghost Adventures: Top 10

overview: Drag queen contestants compete in an elimination-style contest and strut their stuff in a variety of challenges - all to prove that they've got what it takes to be Down Under's next Drag Queen Superstar!
title: Drag Race Down Under

overview: Dr. Ole Alcumbrac owns White Mountain Animal Hospital, a full-service animal clinic in Pinetop, Arizona, that cares for everything from cats and dogs to exotics and large animals. But this self-described 'wild man' isn't your typical veterinarian, and it's his work outside of the clinic that excites him most.
title: The Wild Life of Dr. Ole

overview: FOOLs - Những Kẻ Khờ brings you back to the final moments of the path called youth before the turning point of life. There is joy, sorrow, and remains aching is the feeling of regret. Regrets held in the late confession, in the selfish decisions. Regrets in the one sided love that cannot seem to put into words.
title: FOOLs - Những Kẻ Khờ

overview: Because of the brutal killing of his family, making the young engineer take revenge without waiting for the justice system. But due to carelessness, he is arrested for murdering the father of a woman he secretly loves and is sent to train as an assassin of a secret organization that eliminates evil people illegally. There was a turn of event when he realized he was being used so he decided to withdraw and expose the organization's evil plans. With his own life and his loved one at stake.
title: The Outlaw

overview: Ambitious building block fans of all ages can put their skills to the test in the show. With access to over a million Lego bricks, candidates can show that they are unbeatable in originality, skill and perseverance. After a season moderated by Oliver Geissen, which was shown the evening before, Daniel Hartwich took over the moderation of the show, which will now run in prime time.
title: LEGO Masters

overview: French version of the international game show, a LEGO building contest! The show is hosted by magician and comedian Eric Antoine, who oversees eight pairs of builders as they face off in a series of brick-based challenges.
title: LEGO Masters

overview: A med student with a supernatural gift tries to cash in on his abilities by facing off against ghosts, until a wandering spirit brings romance instead.
title: Let's Fight Ghost

overview: Teams of two LEGO enthusiasts compete to build the best Lego project. In each episode, participants will have to face tasks and create spectacular structures from Lego bricks. It will test the participants' abilities, creativity, imagination and technical skills. At the end of each episode, the weakest couple will leave the show. The best 3 pairs will compete for the final and it will be a real clash of the champions! The winner will receive the title of Lego Master and a prize of PLN 100,000!
title: LEGO Masters

overview: The technology group Lindemann is testing self-driving cars that are about to be launched on the market. One evening a woman dies on an unauthorized test drive. A lawyer and a dropout want to clarify the case.
title: Breaking Even

overview: Five friends from college chase their post-grad dreams of becoming a successful writer, film director, singer, rich wife and out-and-proud hair stylist.
title: Reality of Dream

overview: A young man from a humble family is drawn into a life of crime and soon confronts a determined cop in hot pursuit.
title: Fatal Destiny

overview: A successful DJ's bachelor life is turned upside down when a young woman arrives, claiming to be his long lost daughter.
title: Accidental Daddy

overview: Everyone meets each other on the street. People live, work and make contact in the street. It is a place where different generations and cultures grapple with today's issues. There is a different story behind every door.
title: Onze Straat

overview: In a race against time, two duos of famous Dutch people search for clues in specially built spectacular escape rooms. Who will be the first to crack the code and be able to leave the room?
title: Code van Coppens

overview: Seven people who suffer from severe and sometimes special illnesses are followed for a year. They live towards an all-important medical procedure.
title: Mijn Leven in Hun Handen

overview: The challenges are in line for Martin Johnsrud Sundby in the World Cup season. Can he really defend his gold?
title: Sundby mot verden

overview: Bucket List with The Boz follows outspoken college football legend, Brian "The Boz" Bosworth, as he tours eight of the best destinations in college football today, interviewing coaches, former star players and fans to determine why each stadium deserves a spot on every fan's bucket list.
title: Bucket List with The Boz

overview: An engineer gives up his lucrative career to become a private detective.
title: Detective in the House

overview: Meet hopeful house enthusiasts and follow along as they build their dream home. Magnificent architecture, incomparable surroundings and innovative ideas await when no vision is too difficult to realize. Architecture critic Mark Isitt guides us through the process, from the very first sod to the last.
title: Grand Designs Sverige

overview: An environmental police officer uncovers a hidden world of mythological entities from Brazilian folklore when he finds a connection between the mysterious appearance of a dead river dolphin on a Rio de Janeiro beach and the death of his beloved wife.
title: Cidade Invisível

overview: Martin Pedersen was the rich boy who was to become an actor, but who ended up becoming «Norges største bankraner» (Norway's biggest bank robber). The series illuminates a unique Norwegian crime story, not only told by the perpetrator himself, but also by the police who hunted him, and the ransom victims who remained.
title: Norges største bankraner

overview: Show about Snefrid Antonsen (64) and Erik Hagen (67) becoming influencers.
title: Snefrid og Erik blir influensere

overview: We follow the work of planning, renovation, large-scale opening and eventually daily operation of the spectacular hotel and meeting place Britannia Hotel. Viewers not only meet Odd Reitan, but also get to know many of the personalities who play an important role in making Britannia the extraordinary hotel of their dreams.
title: Britannia Hotel

overview: A suspenseful revenge drama about a woman whose life was destroyed by the friends she trusted most. After making up her mind to take revenge on those who betrayed her, she returns to reclaim the life that was stolen from her.
title: Miss Monte-Cristo

overview: Throughout his life, Harald Rønneberg has done things he cannot. Now he will get to know really well with a bunch of inspiring Norwegians, and together they will complete eight challenges Harald has dreamed of for a long time. Because as he usually says: There is a limit to how much shit can go!
title: Helt Harald

overview: After the success of Farmen, and the fight against cancer, Lothepus is ready for new adventures. After Fjorden Cowboys, we meet a more reflective man, who dreams of following in the footsteps of the pioneers. In each episode of Expedition Lothepus, our hero and a famous guest are on a trip to a new destination. There are hard-hitting activities, challenges and discussions about life around the campfire.
title: Ekspedisjon Lothepus

overview: Henriette Vasstrand is the Norwegian champion in boxing who lived with intoxication and violence. Now she will follow others out of intoxication. It was much tougher than she had thought.
title: Krigerhjerte

overview: Mikka and Noah do not know each other, they are in their early 20s and are desperately chasing the perfect life in their own way. They take drugs to perform better and escape from everyday life, but now the price is getting too high.
title: LOVER

overview: Showcasing Turkey of the 1960s, while it follows a film producer who will tell the story of survival in Yeşilçam as he experiences the golden age of Turkish cinema.
title: Yeşilçam

overview: Jean White is an antiques dealer who runs a successful business with her husband, Rory. But when he suddenly dies and leaves her nearly penniless, Jean relocates to their one remaining asset - a cottage in French antiques hub Saint Victoire - and begins investigating Rory's mysterious death.
title: The Madame Blanc Mysteries

overview: CMT has paired with Skyville Live to bring you 10 specials celebrating the music of legendary artists. In each of the 10 specials, you'll get to see new collaborations from some of the biggest artists, past and present, all performed pre-pandemic in front of an intimate studio audience at Skyville Live in Nashville. Favorites in entertainment and music featured in the specials include Cyndi Lauper, Graham Nash, the late Gregg Allman, Emmylou Harris, a salute to Jerry Lee Lewis, Martina McBride and more.
title: Skyville Live

overview: An exploration of the queen's life, through her diaries, journals and letters, as well as other items in the royal archives. Narrated by Miriam Margolyes.
title: Queen Victoria: In Her Own Words

overview: The story of four young heroes hailing from the prominent families of Wulin; Feng Jun Long, Bao Shao Qing, Xu Ling Xiu and Sima Yan who work together to investigate the famed murderer "Bian Fu (Bat)". In the midst of investigation, they unveil the mystery left behind by the good and evil forces of Jianghu twenty years ago. From constantly suspecting one another to eventually attaining mutual trust and support, the four youths went through numerous tribulations and challenges, bravely pursuing the ideal jianghu and justice of their hearts.
title: The Story of the Bat

overview: How the modern youth of Ivano-Frankivsk lives. "Що Коїться!" series is stories of five completely different residents of Ivano-Frankivsk. Against the background of local streets, the characters talk about their everyday life. The youth drama was created by a group of enthusiasts. The organizers say that the plot of the series is completely fictional and does not concern the real life of the actors.
title: Що Коїться!

overview: Chris Bavin helps families sample rural living to see if it could bring them a new lease of life.
title: Wanted: The Simple Life

overview: Across America, little girls and boys compete in pageants in hopes of impressing the judges with their beauty, personality and costumes. Catch up with some of the pageant superstars years later to see what they are up to now.
title: Toddlers & Tiaras: Where Are They Now?

overview: Stories of people, including First Nations people, who live off the grid in remote regions of Northern Canada, and how they spend their day-to-day lives.
title: Life Below Zero: Canada

overview: A century before the events of Game of Thrones, two unlikely heroes wandered Westeros: a young, naive but courageous knight, Ser Duncan the Tall, and his diminutive squire, Egg. Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes, and dangerous exploits await these improbable and incomparable friends.
title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

overview: How high is Norwegian artists' musical IQ? Host Anders Hoff and team captains Silya Nymoen and Jakob Schøyen Andersen test what our artists know about what they actually do, music. The artists are put to a real test in the studio, and viewers at home can join in and guess: What is your musical IQ? Are you a Mozart or a Mads Hansen?
title: Den du veit

overview: The shorts will feature the main Muppets cast (including Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, Fozzie Bear, Gonzo, Animal, Dr. Bunsen Honeydew, Beaker, Pepe the King Prawn, the Muppet Newsman, Bobo the Bear, Sam the Eagle, Rowlf the Dog, Bubba the Rat, Rizzo the Rat, Foo-Foo and Beauregard) interviewing real kids about various different things, such as apologies, favorite foods and manners.
title: Muppet Moments

overview: A young woman joins forces with a UFO enthusiast to investigate her boyfriend's sudden disappearance and stumbles into a wild conspiracy.
title: Glitch

overview: Winter pushes wildlife to the extreme. For some, it is a chance to thrive; for others, the only way to escape the icy hold of winter is to shut down every physical system. When spring finally comes, it is a time for celebration for those who managed to survive the most brutal of seasons.
title: Winter's Hidden Wonders

overview: Double Cross with Blake Griffin serves up an incredibly devious twist as it offers a service to those who are all too often the victims of a prank. Each week, Griffin conspires with people who are tired of being the victim to help them get some sweet revenge on their unsuspecting prankster - by pulling off the ultimate double cross!
title: Double Cross with Blake Griffin

overview: Shah, heir to the Kg Baru Gangster throne, decides to cut ties with the underworld after falling in love with a girl from a rival gang. Things spin out of control when he's asked to do "one last job" and he unwittingly discovers a plot that will change the fate of the KL Gangsters forever.
title: KL Gangster: Underworld

overview: In a frightening yet friendly competition, paranormal investigators Jack Osbourne and the Ghost Brothers - Dalen Spratt, Marcus Harvey and Juwan Mass - come together to freak each other out with the craziest and creepiest paranormal footage they can find. These guys have each faced their fair share of paranormal disturbances, so they know what's real ... and what's really freaky. It's an uproarious and jaw-dropping battle of the paranormal.
title: Fright Club

overview: On Boxing Day 1999, Charlotte Meyer, an 11-year-old girl, disappears without a trace. Captain Pierre Castaing, in charge of the investigation, fails to find her. A few hundred kilometres away, a young investigator is confronted with a similar disappearance...
title: La Promesse

overview: A team of police officers attached to Interpol is tasked with tracking down fugitives and finding missing persons abroad. The protagonists, Louise Lefranc, a cop haunted by the unsolved disappearance of a teenage girl; Captain Kieffer, an Interpol policeman; Myriam Zarka, a gifted with diplomas; and Lieutenant Marciano, a new recruit who is looking for a second wind ... all will have to unravel affairs with international ramifications that will lead them from Italy to Germany or Tunisia, wherever a French national who has disappeared or has fled may be found.
title: Interpol

overview: Assembly Required reunites Tim Allen with Richard Karn in this new competition series that spotlights the best and brightest builders from across the country, at their home workshops, as they compete to breathe new life into everyday household items in desperate need of fixing. This new series will push each contestant to their limits while testing their ability and ingenuity to not only rebuild it but to build it better. In each episode, Allen and Karn will also dive into the unique history around these items to celebrate the men and women who crafted them, and the techniques used.
title: Assembly Required

overview: A story about the fate of two Krakow families, the action takes place in the years 1874-1914.
title: Z biegiem lat, z biegiem dni...

overview: Set in the early 1950s, Lessons in Chemistry follows Elizabeth Zott, whose dream of being a scientist is put on hold in a society deeming that women belong in the domestic sphere, not the professional one. When Elizabeth finds herself pregnant, alone and fired from her lab, she musters the ingenuity only a single mother has. She accepts a job as a host on a TV cooking show, and sets out to teach a nation of overlooked housewives - and the men who are suddenly listening - a lot more than recipes... all the while craving a return to her true love: science.
title: Lessons in Chemistry

overview: Celebrity guests challenge three gourmet chefs to recreate, then reimagine classic fast foods.
title: Fast Foodies

overview: Shunsuke works part-time at a cafe owned by his uncle Takehiko. One night, a woman, who is dressed like a traditional oiran (high ranking courtesan), appears in front of him. The woman's name is Senka. Apparently, she just travelled across time from the Edo period to the present day and she looks completely lost. Shunsuke takes her to his uncle's house where he also stays. Senka stays at Takehiko's house and also begins to work part-time at his cafe. Senka gets people's attention due to her appearance and behavior. Meanwhile, Shunsuke goes to the library to find information about Senka. He learns that Senka was a legendary oiran in the Edo period.
title: EdoMoiselle

overview: Eiichi Shibusawa was born in 1840 to a farmer's family. He grew up helping his family with work, which was to manufacture and sell indigo production and also silk farming. He left his hometown at the age of 23 and began working for the government. He later travelled to Paris and learned about banking. Upon his return to Japan, he helped build up the first modern bank in Japan. He eventually became a founder or supporter to about 500 companies and was involved with about 600 public services, including education for women.
title: Seiten wo Tsuke

overview: Submarines today are highly complex machines crammed with technology and weapons. As impressive as their construction is, as terrifying is their destructive power. Hardly any other weapon triggers as many emotions as the submarine. It strikes from ambush and can use nuclear missiles to drag the whole world into the abyss. Submarines originated from a completely non-military idea, namely to be able to view the world under water. But the interest in the military use of submarines soon prevailed.
title: Das U-Boot

overview: Whether we work there as a teacher, study there or drop our children off there every morning, the school leaves no one indifferent. Depressed teachers, stressed parents and happy schoolchildren, Pep's takes us back into the daily life of this infernal triangle. In front of the gate, in the canteen, in the corridors or in the classrooms, relationships intertwine for the better... and often for the worse!
title: Pep's

overview: The family of the northerners for the eleventh time comes to rest in the guesthouse to the family of the southerners. Sasha, the eldest son of the northerners, wants to propose to Lucy, the daughter of the southerners, with whom he has been friends since childhood. But Sasha does not yet know that she has a boyfriend. Sasha's mother Larisa, tired of the antics of Seva's unlucky husband, decides to divorce. Seva has time until the end of her vacation to save her marriage. Unlike them, southerners have just begun their relationship. Borya, a poor, but very cunning owner of a guesthouse, recently began to live with the beauty Madina. But the former, the richest man in the city of Taimuraz, is trying with all his might to return her. This is the story of two families, in each of which people are fighting for love.
title: Отпуск

overview: Your journey with 1. FC Köln continues - and again it leads into the unknown: In the 2020/21 season, reality is again writing the script for 24/7 FC. For the first time in German professional soccer, the FC stars will even be wired on the pitch. You're closer than ever before!
title: 24/7 FC

overview: The strange death of an influential member of the parliament, who gets poisoned while being a judge of a reality cooking show, leads to a series of puzzling events and chaos throughout the nation. Who is the murderer? Why was she poisoned?
title: Beauty and the Bullet

overview: Inspired from a true story, Jeet Ki Zid is a tale of conviction, persuasion and commitment. It follows the life of a Special forces officer Major Deep Singh who is left paralyzed waist below after fighting the Kargil war, but his army training and never-give-up attitude help him get back to life and eventually on his feet despite all odds.
title: Jeet Ki Zid

overview: Iris and Tomer are two theater nobodies whose five-year relationship ends in a rough breakup. But just as Tomer leaves the house, he gets a surprising text telling him that Israel's biggest theater is interested in picking up their mutual dream project. Now they must brave working together as exes in the rehearsal room alongside the pair of narcissistic television stars whom the theater insisted on casting for the lead roles in the semi-autobiographical play.
title: Chazarot

overview: Jin Nam Joo is kicked from the first day of the new year to his boyfriend, who he believed was fate. The fortune teller's dad predicts that three men of destiny will appear to his daughter, Jin Nam Joo. A romantic comedy that finds the 'Chin' Nam Joo of life.
title: Life of Namjoo

overview: Tónlistarmennirnir Okkar is a documentary and interview series where Auðunn Blöndal meets some of the country's most beloved musicians, follows them in play and work and reviews their careers.
title: Tónlistarmennirnir Okkar

overview: Beautiful and personal aspects supervised by Andrea Eyland for most of the first three years of the lives of children and their parents. We follow small and large families and look into their lives and talk to experts about important issues related to these precious early years.
title: Líf dafnar

overview: Cherry Healey delivers some insider beauty and fashion tips on how to roll back the years.
title: 10 Years Younger: Quick Tricks

overview: At Ol Pejeta, Kenya's vast and beautiful wildlife conservancy, viewers are taken inside the lives of an incredible cast of wild animals - from elephants and hippos to lions, hyenas and ostriches.
title: Secret Safari: Into the Wild

overview: Breaking Amish follows a fresh group of young men and women as they leave their conservative, rural communities behind for a chance to live in New York and fully experience English life. The new cast of five heads to Brooklyn, N.Y., to explore life beyond their Amish culture. Throughout their journey, their relationships are tested and life-altering choices must be made. By leaving their communities, they risk changing their lives and ties with their families for good, but they all believe that the chance to live in New York and pursue their dreams is well worth it. This season presents new and different challenges as the cast adjusts to life in Brooklyn, where the cultures are countless and the temptations are at an all-time high. Using this opportunity to find themselves, the cast navigates through the nuances of the Brooklyn lifestyle and also makes time to visit the famous New York City landmarks to enjoy all the English things that the city has to offer. While they all have similar, conservative backgrounds, they must get used to not only a new city, but also each other and endure growing pains along the way. The trip to Brooklyn chronicles the tough decisions they must make to leave their families and friends behind.
title: Breaking Amish

overview: After the First 48 revisits some of the most powerful cases originally featured on the First 48 and features exclusive interviews with detectives, prosecutors, defense attorneys, and families of victims. After the First 48 takes viewers through the dramatic and emotional inside story; from the investigation, to the murder trial itself, the verdict and beyond.
title: After the First 48

overview: Sing Again is an upcoming program produced by the staff of the 'Sugarman' series which aims to provide a performing stage for singers and stars who never got to see the light of stardom during their days, or stars who were once big names but are now forgotten by today's youths.
title: Sing Again

overview: Half-Fifty is a comedy drama about youth and growth, and the series follows a group of 25-year-olds who end up in the world of YouTubers.
title: Half-Fifty

overview: In the all-new Mud Mountain Haulers, bigger paydays beckon men to risk it all in the kilometre-high Cariboo Mountains of B.C. This character-driven docu-series focuses on one of the most dangerous jobs on land - logging and log hauling - and no one is willing to go steeper or higher than third-generation loggers Craig and Brent Lebeau and their crews. For a decade, the two brothers were at loggerheads, unwilling to cede an inch or a machine to the other. But wicked weather, a series of setbacks, and a declining industry have forced the Lebeau brothers to bury the axe and work together.
title: Mud Mountain Haulers

overview: Documentary series charting the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening.
title: A Wild Year on Earth

overview: This England will tell the tale of some of the most devastating events to ever befall the United Kingdom, and of a Prime Minister leading in these unprecedented times. The drama will trace the impact on Britain from this once in a generation pandemic, and the response of scientists, nurses, and doctors as they worked tirelessly and heroically to contain and overcome the virus. It is based on the first-hand testimony of people from all walks of life; from Number 10 Downing Street, the Department of Health, The Scientific Advisory Group for Emergencies (SAGE), and from hospitals and care homes across the country.
title: This England

overview: Holey Moley is a whimsical land where mini golf and massive fun is par for the course! Australia's most skilled and passionate golfers will come from across the land to take on the most epic mini golf course ever created, but only a new breed of contender will survive this competition. Towering windmills, fire-breathing dragons, shark-infested lagoons and a giant sausage – it's the course that has everything. No inch of astroturf has been left unturned in creating this unmatched test of precision putting and stamina.
title: Holey Moley Australia

overview: Love between step-brothers. Love between a teacher and a student. A junior who wants to flirt and a senior who got carried away. Follow the various complicated love stories among friends that are interconnected.
title: Brothers

overview: In "De Hoofdprijs" the personal lives of three families are effected when two of the families win a large amount of money. Both price winner families handle the new situation completely different. The third family always has been rich, but will they always be? Are love and happiness for sale?
title: De Hoofdprijs

overview: Deal Lover is the story of a homeowner, Grandma Un, whose daughter got a job overseas. Therefore she must sell her house and go to live with his family in London. But selling a home for a homeowner like Grandma Un becomes somewhat unusual. Grandma Un decides to sell the house to Milan, a young blogger and her younger brother Tokyo. Grandma Un's forgetfulness makes buying the house a mistake after she meets Din who inquires about Un's house after his mother's death. On the day of the contract signing, both Milan and Din show up to make their claim on the house. After quarreling, Un offers for them to try to live in the home together for 7 days. As for Tokyo, Milan's brother met with a close friend until a love develops. Proceeding under the mission to conquer the house How will the story end?
title: Deal Lover

overview: In a Luxembourg village where everyone is keeping secrets, gruff police inspector Luc Capitani investigates the suspicious death of a 15-year-old girl.
title: Capitani

overview: Uri and Ella are father and daughter dealing with the death of the matriarch, Tami, after battling cancer. Uri, a singer with a long and illustrious career is trying to open the second chapter of his life. Ella, without plans or direction, is looking for herself in between opportunities, men and temporary jobs.
title: Uri and Ella

overview: First Australians chronicles the birth of contemporary Australia as never told before, from the perspective of its first people. First Australians explores what unfolds when the oldest living culture in the world is overrun by the world's greatest empire.
title: First Australians

overview: Although Edgar Aquin can go unnoticed by his appearance, he is a formidable investigator, with an extraordinary sense of observation. With his unconventional methods, sharp instincts and unique logic, he will succeed in proving the guilt of the suspects every time!
title: Edgar

overview: An adventure game mixing culture, sport and discovery that involves 5 teams of 3 candidates in search of the secrets of a prestigious civilization beyond our borders.
title: Mission Millenium : Le Masque de Chac

overview: In his new series Adam Liaw's Roadtrip for Good, the cook, author and TV presenter visits bushfire-affected regions as they spring back to life. Over four episodes, Adam unearths some of the best food Australia has to offer, making mouth-watering Asian-inspired dishes with the produce he collects along the way. He meets with locals and discovers that these resilient communities are rebuilding and ready to welcome visitors back with open arms.
title: Adam Liaw's Roadtrip for Good

overview: How much does a story change as it gets retold? Introducing Narrative Telephone! It all starts with Matthew Mercer weaving a quick story set in Wildemount. His recording will be sent off to a fellow cast member to be viewed JUST ONCE, and then retold to the best of their recollection. Once the story has passed through each cast member, we'll compare where it starts to where it ends and see just how much the story changes.
title: Narrative Telephone
